description: Bitcoin Alpha web-of-trust (SNAP). 24,186 trust ratings among 3,783 traders over 1901.0 days. Same structure as bitcoin-otc on a different platform, so the pair tests whether results transfer between two similar ecosystems.
graph_edges_are: a trust rating given between two traders
edge_attributes_available: RATING, integer -10..+10 in column 2, sign and magnitude, as for bitcoin-otc. Unused by TGAP.
edge_attributes_note: The real-data experiments use only temporal interaction topology. Dataset-specific edge weights and signs are not used by the existing TGAP transformations or metrics, so they are recorded as available-but-unused rather than averaged away.
